answer.summary: Deterministic Spring context startup failure, not a flake. The change adds a JPQL query in PayloadIdentityRepository (findAllActionIdsByTenantIdWithOlderVersionsInUse) that JSqlParser rejects at line 15, column 68 on the token "ANDi", likely a typo. The application context fails to load, so every AppTest test fails with the same cause, and later context-based tests fail on the cached failure. Re-running will fail the same way. Fix the query in PayloadIdentityRepository.java.
